results.title: Waiting on God and Finding Joy in the Morning
results.content: We're on our last lesson titled Wait on the Lord.**. So, if they were doing for example lesson 13 in the Psalms, they would say wait on the Lord be of good courage and he shall strengthen your heart. So, our lesson wait on the Lord. **“Wait on the Lord; Be of good courage, And He shall strengthen thy heart; Wait, I say, on the Lord.”**. It's going to seem that wickedness triumphs but just wait on the Lord, in faith and trust and courage God is going to work. The more I thought about it, the Peace of a wean child, this is talking about a child of God who has peace because they trust in God. Psalm 131 points this out as we wait upon the Lord as children of God. We can have peace. Thus, the Sabbath rest is essential to God's people because it empowers them to trustingly wait upon the Lord to fulfill his covenantal promises.”**.
